race.comment: Lots of these close to a win. SATTVA (12) is a six start maiden who has been knocking the door with back to back seconds after trying to lead throughout. Placed only try soft and both career placings have been this trip. Has a low draw and will take catching again. APACHE SUNRISE (5) is another overdue. Has placed 7/11 and put together a string of minors lately. Has been running on hard and looks tough to stop again. FAKE FICTION (7) place don the ballarat Synthetic fresh then midfield there last time. Back to the turf and can improve third-up. THE JUDGE RULED (3) is heading the right way and gets his chance to get off the mark.
